Leopoldstadt (02. Bezirk) — Vienna, Austria

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Leopoldstadt's Praterstern square, a major rail/U-Bahn hub, is the most consistently documented safety hotspot among Vienna's districts. It has held a weapon- and alcohol-prohibition zone since February 2019, with police reporting 586 weapons (480 knives) confiscated there by early 2026, and it was one of the locations featured in ORF's November 2025 documentary on Vienna's 'forbidden zones,' alongside repeated meinbezirk.at reports of undercover drug-dealing arrests at the square (cannabis sales to plainclothes officers in 2022 and 2023). A 2025 district-count ranking (oe24) placed Leopoldstadt fourth in the city with 11,770 recorded offences. Outside the immediate Praterstern area, the rest of the sizeable district (Prater park, Karmelitermarkt, Augarten) is not flagged in press coverage with similar concerns, so the yellow/red rating here reflects Praterstern specifically rather than the whole district; day traffic through the hub sees occasional dealing arrests (yellow), while night is where press and police measures (weapon ban, knife seizures) most consistently describe a red-flagged trouble spot. Sources checked: ORF/OTS press release, November 2025; meinbezirk.at, January 2023; meinbezirk.at, July 2022; meinbezirk.at, March 2026; oe24.at, April 2025.
